course_name_original: Técnicas de Expresión Oral y Escrita en Inglés
course_name_en: Oral and Written Expression Techniques in English
prerequisites: Prior knowledge of grammatical and linguistic structures in English.
Communicative competence at B2 level, according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages.

learning_outcomes.text: Follow and deliver simple oral presentations, making correct use of intonation and expressive possibilities.
Request and offer services related to the work environment, using varied, precise, and appropriate vocabulary for the situation in question.
Participate in meetings and seminars by taking notes, expressing own ideas, and making proposals.
Handle routine requests for goods or services over the phone.
Draft and understand formal reports and common professional correspondence in accordance with established rhetorical, grammatical, and lexical norms.

syllabus_topics: Elaboration of technical reports: structure and linguistic characteristics
Participating in socio-professional activities within the company framework:
Conducting job interviews and presenting CVs
Participating in debates, meetings, and negotiations
Use of language and linguistic signaling techniques
Use of visual aids and body language
Use of voice: rhythm and emphasis

assessment_methods.method: Partial exam (E1): Written individual exam on a cover letter
Practical work (T1): Submission of individual Curriculum Vitae
Partial exam (E2): Oral individual exam on a simulated job interview
Practical work (T2): Written technical report elaborated jointly by two or more students
Partial exam (E3): Written exam on the technical report (individual assessment of linguistic and content aspects)
Partial exam (E4): Group debate participation, individually assessed
Partial exam (E5): Individual oral presentation on a technological innovation topic
Class participation (C1): Active participation in practical sessions

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the final grade is calculated as the sum of E1 + T1 + E2 + T2 + E3 + E4 + E5 + E6 + C1, requiring a score of 5 or higher to pass. There is no minimum score for individual evaluable elements, but 80% attendance to practical sessions is required for a grade in participation (C1). For extraordinary calls, students take a theoretical and a practical exam. The theoretical exam consists of Prueba 1 (10%), Prueba 2 (10%), Prueba 3 (20%), and Prueba 4 (20%). The practical exam is Trabajo práctico (T1) (40%). A score of 5 or higher is required to pass, and previous grades from the ordinary call are not kept. For non-ordinary assessment, students must contact the course coordinator at the beginning of the course.
